kv_storage.placement: stack-local (T_band2__npg4_s5, main 952c5933c): every SM streams only its own HBM stack's rows through its 64-b KV descriptor port; window ring AND compressed rows replicated in all 4 stacks (+3 + 3 row writes/layer/token)
kv_storage.row: 4 lines x 136 B, chunk-position-major: line i, half h, lane j = head dim 8j + 2i + h
kv_storage.SM-KV8: window rows: byte [64h+j] = E4M3 code; line0 bytes 128..135 = UE8M0 blocks 0..7, line1 = blocks 8..15 (block = 32 dims); lines 2,3 spare = 0
kv_storage.SM-KV4: compressed rows: nibble [64h+j] = E2M1 code (sign bit 3); bits 512..767 = 32 E4M3 scales (block = 16 dims) in every line
kv_storage.writer_obligation: the KV writer (QUANT / compressor DMA.STORE path) emits this permutation and the scale bytes; DMA ROW_GATHER copies whole rows
kv_storage.SM-KV8-128: Qwen HD128: one136-byte line/row; byte16*t+j is E4M3 code of dimension8*j+t (t0..7,j0..15); bytes128..131 are fourUE8M0 scales, one per32dimensions; bytes132..135 reserved. Actual Qwen per-elementFP8 can useUE8M0=127; component proof uses123.

sm_modes.QK: HD512: mixed-format op with cfg_n8 window rows then KV4 rows; eight rows/wave, eight steps/row. HD128:32rows/wave, four rows per beat (one per16-lane leaf); eight ring slots x eight steps; bypass four-leaf combine to return four scores/beat. NCOL independent query images share K beats (Qwen NCOL4).
sm_modes.PV: HD512: existing aligned chunk runs. HD128:128tokens/op split into four32token contiguous streams, descriptor visits streams round-robin, two64-lane beats per token; ring slot2*stream+beat; each stream accumulates four8token chunks and publishes128dimensions per query head. Two PV ops/SM/KVhead cover256tokens. X store supports at most128pwords/op.
sm_modes.cross_sm: SM nodes merged in pairwise SM-index order (quadrant-local pairs first, then across quadrants) by a fixed-slot reduce-scatter; +0 pads may be skipped (exact)
